explanation: It is non-zero only at D1, when the previous trial chose a2, reached S2 by the common transition and was rewarded: about 9-10 in the first ~35 trials of the episode, about 5-7 around trials 38-56, and 0 later on (if that a2->S2 trial went unrewarded it is about 1). Every GO and D2 step is 0, and so is every D1 that follows an a1 choice or a rare transition, rewarded or not.
